marta: Opening a tiny quickstart tidy PR 1: add a Go example, swap out the curl block, normalize env vars, and fix a broken auth anchor. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4456.

devin: Can you paste the Go snippet here so i can check the auth usage and imports?

marta: sure 1 minimal Go example below (sync):
```go
package main

import (
  "fmt"
  "os"
  redwood "github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk"
)

func main() {
  client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{APIKey: os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")})
  resp, _ := client.Generate(redwood.GenerateParams{Model: "gpt-rt-1", Input: "hello quickstart"})
  fmt.Println(resp.Text)
}
```

samir: nice. please also update the docker and compose examples to use REDWOOD_API_KEY (people copy-paste). also note the container image has been retagged to redwood/hello:go-2026-03.
